sources.finding: FERPA defines education records as records directly related to a student and maintained by the school or a party acting for it; disclosure of personally identifiable information requires prior written consent that is signed/dated and specifies the records, purpose, and recipient, unless an exception (e.g., the school-official exception for contractors with a legitimate educational interest) applies. This grounds the family-memo disclosure and the school-only/vendor constraint.
